title: Axon Hub | Auto Farm, Auto Bid, Auto Loot, ESP & More
features:
Axon Hub delivers complete automation for Storage Hunters, covering auctions, locker looting, cash farming, vehicles, item processing, shop management and rewards.
AUTO FARM
• Complete automatic farming cycle
• Automatically finds and enters auctions
• Auto Bid with adjustable timing and bid attempts
• Automatically collects locker items and floor loot
• Auto Lockpick for nearby safes
• Automatically loads and unloads truck cargo
• Auto Pawn Sell for quick cash
• Optional shop visits and NPC offer acceptance  
AUCTION TOOLS
• Auto Bid
• Auto XRay to preview locker contents
• Auto Calculator for estimated values
• Auto Kick NPC bidders
• Automatically leave failed auctions
• Adjustable auction delays and waiting times  
REWARDS AND MONEY
• Auto Daily Rewards
• Auto Achievements
• Auto Collection and milestone rewards
• Auto Museum income
• Auto Meteor claims
• Auto Warehouse jobs
• Auto Club Daily rewards
• Auto NPC shop offers  
ITEM AND SHOP AUTOMATION
• Auto Grade valuable items
• Auto Repair broken loot
• Auto Wash dirty items
• Auto Stock shop shelves
• Teleports to Locksmith, Pawn Shop, Museum, Warehouse, Car Shop and other services
• Quick access to lockpicks, drinks, upgrades and item services  
VEHICLE FEATURES
• Auto Spawn Truck
• Auto Unload Truck
• Automatically sit in the driver seat
• Adjustable truck speed
• Load inventory items into the truck
• Spawn, despawn and manage vehicles  
ESP AND VISUALS
• Player, NPC, Vehicle, Item, Prompt and Shop ESP
• Boxes, names, distance and tracers
• Chams and highlights through walls
• Custom ESP colors
• Fullbright and No Fog
• Custom camera FOV and Third Person  
MOVEMENT
• Fly with adjustable speed
• Noclip
• Faster Walk
• Higher Jump and Infinite Jump
• Click Teleport
• Teleport to map locations, players and your shop  
UTILITY
• Anti-AFK
• Anti-Kick and idle-teleport protection
• Anti-Knockdown
• Auto Energy Drink
• Auto Equip latest title
• Rejoin and Server Hop
• Configuration saving
• Optional Discord session statistics webhook
